{{Quote|There was a global election on Kath II. Notable only for the fact that not a single human was elected to office, although fully one third of Kath's population is human. The Diversity Alliance was campaigning heavily there.|[[M-TD]]|<ref name="YJK:DA" />}}
'''Kath II''', also known as '''Kath''', was an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-[[Waterworld/Legends|covered]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==Description==
[[File:Dustig_Trace.png|thumb|left|225px|Kath II was located on the Dustig Trace]]
Kath II, also referred to simply as Kath,<ref name="YJK:DA" /> was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="AIR" /> located in the [[Kath system/Legends|Kath system]], a part of the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

Kath II was the starting point of the [[Dustig Trace]], a short but useful [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] within the Dustig sector, that passed through [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] before ending at [[Demos Four]].<ref name="TEA" /> Kath II was situated on the general route between the planets of [[Kuar]],<ref name="YJK:DA" /> in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]],<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Shumavar/Legends|Shumavar]],<ref name="YJK:DA" /> in the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

Kath II was an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-[[Waterworld/Legends|covered]] world that featured oceanic trenches, such as the [[Karm Trenches]]. It shared its name with the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Kath/Legends|Kath]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="AIR" /> In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> one third of the world's population was [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="YJK:DA" />

==History==
Kath II was located in an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] and [[3000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], at some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Kath subjugation|subjugated]] Kath II. During the battle, many [[Alliance Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] took up positions within the Karm Trenches. The Kath subjugation saw a particularly heavy use by Imperial [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Aquadon CAVa 400]], a personal [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] combat [[Submarine/Legends|vehicle]] derived from the [[Compact Assault Vehicle/Wheeled PX-10|CAVw PX-10]].<ref name="AIR" /> The subjugation of Kath II led to extensive civilian casualties.<ref name="TEA" />

In 24 ABY,<ref name="TERC" /> the [[Diversity Alliance]], an [[Anti-Humanism|anti-Human]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group, [[Propaganda/Legends|campaigned]] heavily on Kath II. As a result, not a single Human was [[Democracy/Legends|elected]] to office after a global election on Kath II, despite the fact that Humans constituted one third of the world's population.<ref name="YJK:DA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The world of Kath was created by [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" /> The world was later mentioned and identified as Kath II in ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Diversity Alliance]]'', a [[1997]] young-adult novel co-authored by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]].<ref name="YJK:DA" />
